## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete user problem and what changes after this PR. Link a related issue if one exists.

## Validation

List checks actually run and their results. Mark relevant checks not run and explain the limitation. Distinguish unit fixtures from native editor, real-model, installation, and remote CI evidence.

## Review notes

Mention shared API/client effects, data/migration implications, documentation updates, and material risks. Remove this section if there is nothing useful to add.

Before submitting, review the diff for credentials, .env, databases, private source, runtime state, model weights, dependency directories, and generated packages. Preserve source/build consistency and existing licensing notices. Follow CONTRIBUTING.md and CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md.
